title: Concentration after an IV dose
caption: A 500 mg dose in V = 50 L gives C₀ = 10 mg/L, and the half-life of 4 hours means k = 0.693/4 ≈ 0.173 per hour: the concentration is 5 mg/L at 4 hours and 2.5 mg/L at 8.
alt: A decaying curve of concentration starting at 10 milligrams per litre, passing 5 at 4 hours and 2.5 at 8 hours.
description: The dose of 500 mg in V = 50 L gives C₀ = 10 mg/L.
Each 4 hours the concentration halves: 5 mg/L at 4 h, 2.5 mg/L at 8 h, 1.25 mg/L at 12 h.
The decay rate is k = 0.693/4 ≈ 0.173 per hour and the clearance is CL = kV ≈ 8.7 L/hour.
